author: ruixen.ui
name: hero-page
description: This component is a modern hero section designed to immediately capture attention and showcase dynamic visual content. The heading combines text and an animated image card to create an interactive, eye-catching effect, where the card smoothly transitions between multiple visuals, giving the impression of motion and life. The text is carefully styled with large, bold, and well-spaced typography to ensure readability while maintaining a modern aesthetic. Below the heading, a card is positioned as a continuation of the visual flow, providing a call-to-action or highlight that aligns with the heading content. The component is fully responsive, using Tailwind CSS for layout and spacing, and Framer Motion for smooth animations. The overall design balances text, visuals, and interactive elements, making it ideal for landing pages, portfolios, or product showcases where first impressions are critical.
